requirements.quote:
The KEY_UPDATE_ERROR error code (0x0e) is used to signal errors
   related to key updates.
requirements.condition: When signaling an error related to a key update
requirements.required_behavior: Use the KEY_UPDATE_ERROR error code with numeric value 0x0e.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Signal the key-update error under a different error-code value.
requirements.why_checkable: A key-update failure can be induced and the emitted error-code field compared directly with 0x0e.
